identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a secure, institutional, yet emotionally resonant resume feedback system.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Academic Prestige with Cyber-Security Aesthetics.
Emotion First: Trust and Authority are the core emotions.
Content is King: The Resume and Feedback are the heroes.
Zoom In: Focus on the details of digital signatures and encryption status.
Negative Space: Use whitespace to convey clarity and lack of clutter.

headings.usage: All H1-H3 headings. Use for 'University Name', 'Dashboard Titles', 'Security Alerts'.

body.usage: All body text, inputs, buttons, and data tables.

mono.usage: Hashes, Digital Signatures, Encryption Keys, Logs.

layout.spacing_scale: Generous. Use p-8 or p-12 for main containers. p-6 for cards.

containers.card_style: rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200

buttons.primary: bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-md px-6 py-2 font-medium transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-900 border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-md px-6 py-2 font-medium
buttons.ghost: text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-md px-4 py-2

inputs.style: h-11 rounded-md border-slate-200 bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-900 focus:border-transparent transition-all
inputs.label: text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5 block

cards.base: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm p-6

badges.verified: bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200 rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium flex items-center gap-1
badges.pending: bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border border-amber-200 rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium flex items-center gap-1
badges.encrypted: bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium font-mono flex items-center gap-1

landing_hero.usage: Hero section background or side panel on login page.

feedback_process.usage: Teacher dashboard or 'How it works' section.

visual_indicators.encryption: Use a lock icon (Lucide 'Lock') next to resume filenames. Tooltip: 'AES-256 Encrypted'.
visual_indicators.signature: Use a rosette/check icon (Lucide 'BadgeCheck') for signed feedback. Tooltip: 'Digitally Signed by [Teacher Name]'.
visual_indicators.hashing: Display truncated hash (e.g., 'SHA-256: a1b2...c3d4') in mono font below documents.

mfa_screen.style: Clean, centered card. Use 'InputOTP' component for the 6-digit code. Clear instructions.
mfa_screen.icon: ShieldCheck icon in large size (w-12 h-12) with slate-900 color.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use subtle backdrop-blur-md for sticky headers or modal overlays. bg-white/80.
visual_enhancers.noise: Add a very subtle noise texture to the main background to give it a 'paper' feel (optional).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Use 'shadow-sm' for most elements. 'shadow-lg' for modals and dropdowns.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Login' page with a split layout: Image on left, Form on right.
Use 'Playfair Display' for the main 'University Resume Portal' branding.
Ensure the 'Student Dashboard' shows a list of submitted resumes with 'Encryption' status visible.
The 'Teacher Dashboard' must have a 'Review' mode where the resume is on the left and feedback form on the right.
Use 'Sonner' for all notifications (e.g., 'Resume Uploaded Successfully', 'Feedback Signed').
Strictly follow the color palette. Do not use default blue/green. Use the specified Slate/Amber/Emerald shades.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
Use 'sonner' for toasts. Sonner component are located in '/app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx'
